content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts exhibit significant downward bias during periods of high sentiment, consistently underestimating true prices.", "Forecasts fail to capture rapid mean-reversion, lagging behind sharp price increases in the true outcome.", "Sentiment values above 0.67 correlate with model overshoots of the lower bound, indicating a need for sentiment-weighted adjustments.", "The model displays excessive persistence, failing to react to sudden volatility shifts in the first 10 days of the forecast horizon.", "Correction rules must account for the divergence between flat model trajectories and the oscillating nature of actual market prices.", "High sentiment history combined with falling recent prices signals an impending rebound that the model systematically misses.", "Apply a positive bias correction to forecasts when sentiment history shows a sustained upward trend despite recent price dips.", "Reduce forecast persistence when sentiment drops below 0.33 to better align with observed price volatility."]}
